title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework Core
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Documented use and oversight of AI output; defined human oversight; production monitoring; ongoing risk tracking
material_limitations: Voluntary cross-sector guidance currently under revision; it does not prescribe this queue architecture establish self-storage requirements or certify compliance

title: NIST AI 600-1 Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Human-AI configuration; monitoring; risks from inappropriate trust and consequential use of generated output
material_limitations: The profile does not prove a product deployment queue behavior operating result or compliance outcome

title: A Study of Position Bias in Digital Library Recommender Systems
supports: Observed association between displayed rank and clicks in two digital-library recommender-system settings
material_limitations: The study does not measure self-storage work prove the same effect in a facility queue or make a click equivalent to a decision or operating outcome

title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
publisher: Microsoft Research and University of Washington
supports: General interaction guidance on capability communication correction granular feedback controls and cautious adaptation
material_limitations: Validated with design practitioners and general AI-infused products; it is not a facility-operations standard or implementation finding

title: NIST AI 800-4 Challenges to the Monitoring of Deployed AI Systems
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: Need to complement predeployment evaluation with postdeployment testing evaluation validation verification and monitoring of the larger deployed system
material_limitations: The report describes challenges gaps and research needs; it does not certify a monitoring program or this proposed method

title: PROV-DM The PROV Data Model
supports: Representing entities activities agents usage generation attribution and responsibility across a provenance chain
material_limitations: Generic provenance model; it does not authenticate validate or complete a facility event candidate exposure or reviewer record

title: Semantic Conventions for Events
supports: Structured named occurrences with timestamps and attributes for observable system events
material_limitations: Development-status telemetry conventions; instrumentation does not establish business authority event truth queue fairness review quality or operational completion
